need: Test results recorded by make check count for the commit made right after it when that commit holds exactly the tested files, and the results page is rewritten after the commit.

searched.found: _results compares the recorded commit and a clean flag only; the template has pre-commit and pre-push hooks and no post-commit step; no listed capability records a tested tree.

searched.where: git write-tree with GIT_INDEX_FILE (git-scm.com/docs/git-write-tree), git stash create, pytest-testmon, lefthook post-commit
searched.query: identify the exact content that was tested; run a step after commit
searched.found: git's own tree hash identifies the content exactly and a temporary index computes it without touching the real index; git stash create misses untracked files; testmon tracks test dependencies, not the tested content; lefthook runs post-commit jobs like its other hooks.
